title: Draft a communication
description: Turn a short brief into a clear message for colleagues or stakeholders.
example:
Subject: Updated timetable for the pilot
Opening: what is changing and why.
Details: who is affected, the confirmed dates and what recipients need to do.

Illustrative structure; missing facts remain questions or placeholders.

fields.label: Message brief
fields.placeholder: What needs to be communicated, and what should readers do?

fields.label: Audience
fields.placeholder: For example: branch employees, managers or a project team
